opening: The chest pain and the rash started three weeks ago.
I have a few small sores in my mouth.
I have lots of soft lumps on both sides of my neck.
Three months ago I had sex with a commercial sex worker.

opening.text: I've been having chest pain, a rash, and a few small sores in my mouth, along with lots of soft lumps on both sides of my neck. These all started three weeks ago. I had a CT scan at a local hospital three weeks ago that showed several spots in my left lung, and a contrast CT a week later showed them again. I also had upper and lower endoscopies there, and they were normal. Three months ago I had sex with a commercial sex worker.
